exposure.needed: whether any tooling, scripts, or controllers in the customer's environment list Kubernetes events using regardingObject as a field-selector

consequence.statement: Event-listing selectors that use regardingObject pointing at the Pod no longer match the Pod-restart events; the operator must update such selectors to specify the Kafka resource instead.
consequence.remediation: Update any field-selectors that use regardingObject to specify the Kafka resource instead of the Pod.

assertion.statement: Kubernetes events for Pod restarts no longer have the Pod as their `regardingObject`, so anyone using `regardingObject` as a `field-selector` when listing these events must update the selector to specify the Kafka resource instead.
